question: Adityanath Yogi won from which constituency in the 2022 assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gorakhpur (Urban).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Adityanath Yogi won from **Gorakhpur (Urban) constituency **in the 2022 assembly elections
 
• **Yogi Adityanath** (born 5 June 1972) is an Indian Hindu monk and politician serving as the 22nd and current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, in office since 19 March 2017.
 
• He was appointed as the Chief Minister on 26 March 2017 after the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won the 2017 State Assembly elections.
 
• He has been the Member of Parliament from the Gorakhpur constituency, Uttar Pradesh, for five consecutive terms since 1998.
 
• Adityanath is also the Mahant or head priest of the **Gorakhnath Math, a Hindu temple in Gorakhpur.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The original name of Yogi Adityanath is **Ajay Mohan Bisht.** 
 
• He is also the founder of **Hindu Yuva Vahini,** a Hindu Nationalist organization.
 
• Adityanath was preceded by **Akhilesh Yadav.**
 
• Governor of Uttar Pradesh - **Anandiben Patel**
 
• DGP of Uttar Pradesh - **H. C. Awasthy**
